source: Permit PDF p1 配置圖 1:500 (rendered 8x, 45.35 px/m), lot 318 boundary and building footprint extracted by colour

site_plan_to_en.method: least squares on matched lines: lot frontage vs e-map lane edge, private-road edges vs e-map lane edges, NE lot line vs No.21 wall

house_plan_to_en.matrix: EN = [[cos p, sin p],[sin p, -cos p]] . (plan x, plan y) + t (plan is mirror-handed to EN)
house_plan_to_en.distance_source: Permit A1-3 有效採光範圍檢討表 D values (13 windows/doors)
